meta.scope: South Korea Batch 5 — Further uniqueness and remaining high-value nodes: foreign residents / multicultural statistics, nuclear power & energy generation, Input-Output tables, official North Korea statistical indicators (KOSTAT portal), and supporting structural/energy series. Continues under locked definition.
meta.strategy_note: Uncovers additional distinctive features: growing migrant/multicultural population, high nuclear share in electricity (~32 %), inter-industry structure, and the unique official compilation of North Korea statistics by South Korean authorities.

candidates.title: Foreign Residents / Migrant population statistics and Multicultural Family / Marriage statistics
candidates.publisher: Statistics Korea (KOSTAT) / Ministry of Justice / related agencies
candidates.description: Statistics on the stock and characteristics of foreign residents / migrants (age, nationality, education, employment, living arrangements), multicultural marriages, and births to multicultural parents. Foreign resident population has grown substantially and is increasingly material to labour-supply and demographic analysis.
candidates.notes: Parallel to Japan’s foreign-residents cluster. Korea’s migrant population (ethnic Korean Chinese, Vietnamese and other Asian nationalities prominent) is a growing structural feature that interacts with ultra-low fertility and labour shortages. Multicultural marriage and birth statistics are recurringly cited in demographic and social-policy discussion.

candidates.title: Nuclear power generation and electricity generation mix statistics
candidates.publisher: Korea Power Exchange / Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power / Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources / related agencies
candidates.description: Statistics on nuclear electricity generation, capacity, utilisation rates and share of total generation (recently ~32 %, the highest in 15 years), together with the broader electricity generation mix (nuclear, coal, LNG, renewables).
candidates.notes: High-value uniqueness node. Korea maintains a large, high-utilisation nuclear fleet that supplies roughly one-third of electricity — a sharp contrast with Japan’s post-Fukushima trajectory. Directly relevant to energy-security, industrial-cost and climate-policy analysis. Complements industrial-production and export competitiveness (energy-intensive manufacturing).

candidates.title: Input-Output Tables / Inter-industry relations tables
candidates.description: Periodic detailed input-output tables showing inter-industry transactions, value added and final demand. Used for multiplier analysis, supply-chain studies and the compilation of national accounts.
candidates.notes: Structural backbone for understanding Korea’s production linkages, especially the semiconductor, auto and shipbuilding value chains. Parallel to Japan’s Input-Output Tables node. Continuously cited in industrial-policy and trade-impact analysis.

candidates.title: Statistical Indicators of North Korea (북한의 주요통계지표) — KOSTAT / Ministry of Data and Statistics compilation
candidates.publisher: Statistics Korea (KOSTAT) / Ministry of Data and Statistics
candidates.description: Annual official South Korean compilation of major statistical indicators for North Korea (population, fertility, health, agriculture, national accounts estimates, etc.), drawing on available data and estimation methods. Published as ‘Statistical Indicators of North Korea’ and disseminated via the KOSTAT North Korea statistics portal.
candidates.notes: Unique institutional product. South Korea’s statistical authorities systematically compile and publish comparative indicators on North Korea. Meets the node definition as a recurring, titled official statistical publication. Provides the empirical basis for inter-Korean comparisons and is cited in unification, security and development analysis.

candidates.title: Energy balance / Primary energy supply statistics
candidates.publisher: Korea Energy Economics Institute / MOTIR / related agencies
candidates.description: Annual energy balance tables showing primary energy supply by source, transformation and final consumption by sector. Framework for energy-security and carbon-intensity analysis.
candidates.notes: Complements the electricity-generation and nuclear nodes with the full primary-energy picture (including oil, gas, coal and renewables). Essential for industrial energy-cost and climate-policy linkages.

candidates.title: Wage Structure Survey / Labour cost statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Employment and Labor / Statistics Korea
candidates.description: Periodic survey of wages by industry, occupation, firm size, sex and age, together with related labour-cost indicators. Source for gender wage-gap and firm-size wage-differential analysis.
candidates.notes: Deepens the labour and gender clusters. Wage differentials by firm size are particularly relevant in Korea’s dualistic labour market (large enterprises vs SMEs).

candidates.title: Health and medical statistics (beyond long-term care)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Health and Welfare / National Health Insurance Service / KOSTAT
candidates.description: Statistics on health status, medical utilisation, National Health Insurance expenditure, cause of death detail, and related health-system indicators.
candidates.notes: Complements the Long-Term Care and Vital Statistics nodes. Provides the broader health-system picture under rapid ageing.

candidates.title: Agriculture, forestry and fishery statistics
candidates.publisher: Statistics Korea / Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs
candidates.description: Statistics on agricultural production, farm households, fishery production and related rural indicators. Includes structural surveys of farm households.
candidates.notes: Completes the sectoral coverage. While manufacturing and services dominate, agriculture remains relevant for regional economies and food-security policy; also appears in North Korea comparative statistics.

candidates.title: Tourism and culture statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism / Korea Tourism Organization / KOSTAT
candidates.description: Statistics on inbound/outbound tourism, tourism expenditure, cultural participation and related creative-industry indicators.
candidates.notes: Supporting services-sector and soft-power node. Tourism and cultural exports (Hallyu) are material to services trade and national-image analysis.

candidates.title: Crime and justice statistics
candidates.publisher: Supreme Prosecutors’ Office / Korean National Police Agency / KOSTAT / Ministry of Justice
candidates.description: Official statistics on reported crime, clearance rates, prosecution and judicial statistics.
candidates.notes: Social-structure supporting node. Provides the public-safety dimension that interacts with demographic change, urban concentration and social-cohesion analysis.
